what.text: This page follows refugees from Zimbabwe living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 683 Zimbabwean refugees in the United Kingdom, 10.3% of all refugees from Zimbabwe.
South Africa hosts the most Zimbabwean refugees, followed by Ireland, Canada and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Zimbabwe in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 15118, at the end of 2011, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
